$comment: §323 fieldmap SCHEMA v2 for the WebshopSystem hop (INBOUND: WooCommerce on the community website is the source; CEH mirrors sponsor orders → tasks/tier; sponsor contacts come from the ERP). Documents the mapping SponsorOrderPullService implements. READ-ONLY toward the webshop: the WooCommerce REST key is Read-only; CEH never writes orders.

source.notes: Orders filtered to status=completed within the configured OrdersAfter/OrdersBefore window; category names arrive HTML-encoded and are decoded.

target.notes: Idempotent per company (SourceKey sponsor:{companyId}:{title-slug}); tier/package RAISE-ONLY; refunded/cancelled orders raise organizer action items but never roll back.

limitations: orders WITHOUT the _cm_company_id meta are legacy user-meta orders — skipped (cannot attribute)
task titles/descriptions render from sponsor.<edition>.json (placeholders incl. SharePoint folder links)
product classification (SponsorProductClassifier) derives kind + BoothTier + booth number from name + categories

fields.limitations: RAISE-ONLY: a pull never lowers an already-granted tier/package
SourceKey sponsor:{companyId}:{title-slug}; orphans pruned; delivered tasks auto-closed
